title: Registers touched by an extended instruction
statement: Let $W$ be a word width, let $m$ be a memory assigning a $W$-bit word to each integer address, and let $i$ be an extended instruction. Its touched-address set is the base instruction's touched-address set when it is a base instruction; otherwise it consists of the addresses explicitly named by the instruction (one address for emission or coin use, and two for input reads or halving).
